Build a streak you’re proud of.

Flame is a habit tracker and streak counter that makes your consistency visible. Read more, keep up with your workouts, or leave late-night scrolling behind.
From your first few days to your next personal best, see how long you can keep your commitment going.

Features

Build and break habits with streaks
• Build a habit with manual check-ins. Mark it done when you’ve followed through, and add another day to your streak.
• Break a habit with an automatic counter. Your streak grows at midnight without daily check-ins. Reset it when you need a fresh start.
• Choose which days count. Follow a daily routine or set a weekly schedule. Planned days off won’t break your streak.
• Keep your commitments in view with reminders for each habit and home screen widgets.
• Forgot to check in? Update past days from the calendar.
• Missed a day? Use a streak freeze to keep your streak going while recording the missed day, or restart and work toward a new personal best.

Track your consistency
• Review completed days, missed days, and freezes in your habit history.
• Explore your activity heatmap in Insights and see how consistently you’ve kept your habits over the last 30 days.
• Look beyond your current streak with personal bests, lifetime totals, and a record of your comebacks.

Reach milestones and share your streaks
• Set a target to work toward, whether it’s your first week or a longer challenge.
• Earn trophies at 7, 30, 90, 365, and 1,000 days.
• Share achievements with ready-made visuals, or keep them as personal milestones.
• Archive completed streaks to preserve their trophies and make room for your next goal.

Your streak data stays on your phone
• Keep your progress on your device. Export a backup file to save a copy, restore it later, or move your streaks to a new phone.

Habit Rewards is a habit tracker that rewards you for completing your habits and tasks. Every check-off earns coins, points you spend on rewards you choose: a coffee, an episode, a new book, a lazy Sunday. Build the habit, earn the coins, claim the reward.

Use it as your habit tracker, goal tracker and daily routine planner in one. Most habit trackers stop at a checkmark. Habit Rewards turns your daily routine into a reward system you design yourself, so sticking with it feels worth it on day 3, not just on day 90.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Add a habit and pick how hard it is. Harder habits earn more coins.
2. Check it off each day and watch your streak grow.
3. Add rewards and give each one a coin price.
4. When your balance covers a reward, claim it and enjoy it, guilt-free.

A REWARD CHART FOR ADULTS

Reward charts and token systems are not just for kids. Habit Rewards works like a token economy for grown-ups: coins are the tokens, your reward list is the menu. Fill it with small treats for everyday wins and bigger rewards to save up for. Need ideas? Start from ready-made reward samples and make them your own.

HABITS AND TASKS IN ONE APP

- Daily habits, a few times a week, or on the weekdays you choose
- One-off tasks that earn coins too, so the to-do list gets done
- Group habits into morning routine, workout, study or any list you like
- Reminders that arrive when you need them

QUIT A BAD HABIT, TOO

Switch any habit to "Quit a habit": smoking, alcohol, sugar, late-night scrolling. Every day you stay off it earns coins. If you slip, mark the day and it costs coins instead.

STREAKS THAT FORGIVE A BAD DAY

Life happens. Skip a day when you need to, and your streak survives. Forgot to check in yesterday? Check off past days too. One off day should not undo a month of work, because that is the day most people quit.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS

- Streak counter and calendar view for every habit
- Statistics: completion rates, trends, averages and totals
- Home Screen widgets that show today's habits at a glance
- A mood journal alongside your habits

MAKE IT YOURS

- Custom icons, colors and coin amounts for every habit
- Create your own coin types
- Works offline; sign in to back up and sync across devices

HABITS PEOPLE TRACK WITH HABIT REWARDS

- Fitness: workout, steps, running, yoga, stretching
- Health: drink water, sleep on time, take vitamins, cut sugar, no alcohol
- Focus: study, read, deep work, no phone in bed, side project
- Home: make the bed, dishes, laundry, declutter, meal prep
- Mind: meditate, journal, gratitude, breathing exercises
- Challenges: 30-day and 75-day challenges, a no-spend month, Dry January

WHO IT'S FOR

- Anyone who downloaded a habit tracker, used it for four days and stopped
- People who respond better to a reward than to guilt
- Anyone building a dopamine menu of healthy treats who wants to earn them
- Adults who want a self-reward system: points for chores, workouts or study, spent on treats you pick

FREQUENTLY ASKED

Forming a new habit takes consistency. Goal Streak gives you the motivation to keep going by showing you how far you’ve come. Don’t break your streak!

Try out the app with 3 free habits, if you love it - there is a one time charge to upgrade to unlimited habits and app customization options. No subscriptions.

Features
=======

Syncs with Apple Health: Your steps, workouts and mindful minutes can complete your habits automatically.

Customize each habit: Add names, colors, icons, sounds and tags for easy organization.

Set habit frequency: Adjust habit frequency so that it only re-occurs every other day, multiple times a day, or on a weekly basis.

Streak freeze: Need a break? On vacation or just plain ol tired? You can preserve your streak with a streak freeze!

Streak end date: Set a target end date for your streak and get a compelling countdown visualization!

Detailed streak stats: View current streaks, longest streaks, and yearly totals.

Daily reminders: Optionally schedule as many reminders as you'd like to give yourself a gentle nudge to stay on track.

Journal and writing prompts: Growth mindset oriented journaling prompts to reflect on your progress.

Archive old habits: Keep your day focused while saving past progress.

Widgets: Interactive widgets to track daily and weekly progress right from your Home Screen.

Dark mode & themes: Personalize the app theme colors and fonts.

Why you’ll love Goal Streak Calendar:

* Simple, clean design
* Motivating streak visualization
* 100% private – your habits stay yours
* Helps you build consistency and reach your goals

Thanks for checking out the app and happy goal streaking!

RELIEVE BACK PAIN. IMPROVE POSTURE. GET STRONGER WITH AI-POWERED PERSONAL POSTURE THERAPY.

Discover personalized, science-backed physical therapy routines designed specifically for you, right at home. Start by answering a few simple questions, and let our app assess your posture in 360 degrees. Our AI-powered engine will then deliver exercises and stretches tailored to your unique needs.

Your program evolves weekly based on your feedback, just like having a real therapist.

SUFFERING FROM BACK OR NECK PAIN? DEALING WITH PINCHED NERVES? OR DID YOUR BACK GO OUT?

We’ve got targeted exercises to help relieve both acute and chronic pain, wherever it hurts.

This is the world’s best virtual corrective exercise program, fully customized to your pain, posture, and fitness level.

Developed by a Posture Therapist certified by the Egoscue Institute, our app delivers the most effective exercises for lasting pain relief—no appointments, no waiting rooms, no hassle.

FEEL BETTER, FASTER!

Experience quicker, more noticeable results than typical protocols. Here’s what you can expect:

	•	Reduced Pain and Inflammation
	•	Improved Balance
	•	Better Posture
	•	Increased Strength

————————————————————————
FREE 360-DEGREE POSTURE ASSESSMENT

Download the app and take advantage of a comprehensive posture assessment with a detailed report.

Our clients consistently tell us that our posture assessment provides the most thorough yet easy-to-understand explanations of why they’re experiencing pain and discomfort.

For long-term results, upgrade to our personalized Posture Therapy Plan.

————————————————————————

What’s included in the Postureletics Posture Therapy Plan:

	1.	CUSTOMIZED PROGRAM

Your own AI-powered personal trainer creates every exercise routine based on your posture, fitness level, and preferences.

	2.	CONVENIENCE

Short on time or traveling? No equipment? No problem.
Our programs require no special equipment and take only 20 minutes a day.

	3.	PEACE OF MIND

No more confusion. We take the guesswork out by creating a plan that’s specific to you, guiding you step by step.
Just follow the program and experience real, lasting results.

————————————————————————————
